title: Yellow Peruvian Seafood Ceviche Clasico
description: A savory and juicy Peruvian dish featuring seafood marinated in citrus juices, served in a bento box. This recipe is a quick fix and nut free friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the seafood, lime juice, and lemon juice, making sure that the seafood is completely covered with the marinade.
Add the sliced onion, chopped aji amarillo pepper, and minced garlic to the bowl and mix well.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the seafood to marinate.
In a small saucepan, melt the vegetable shortening over low heat.
Remove the bowl from the refrigerator and stir in the melted shortening, salt, and black pepper.
To serve, divide the ceviche among four bento boxes, garnished with corn kernels and chopped cilantro.
Make sure to discard any leftover ceviche after 24 hours.
Keep the bento boxes refrigerated at a temperature of 40 degrees Fahrenheit or below.
